name: Sekirei ~Mirai Kara no Okurimono~
original_name: セキレイ ～未来からのおくりもの～
source:
The game takes place in the Sekirei timeline, being played as a visual novel. Minato and the Sekirei in Izumo Inn encounter new characters consisting of Sekirei No. 54, Kuruse, Sekirei No. 57, Yahan, Ashikabi Reiji Koya  and a baby referred to as Aka-chan. It centers around the discovery of the said baby, who is being pursued by unknown persons after Minato and the Sekirei found her abandoned in the city.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sekirei]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
游戏发生在《鹡鸰女神》的故事时间线中，以视觉小说形式呈现。皆人与出云庄的鹡鸰们遇见了几名新角色，包括第54号鹡鸰来濑、第57号鹡鸰夜半、苇牙甲屋怜治，以及一个被称作“小宝宝”的婴儿。皆人与鹡鸰们在城里发现她遭人遗弃，此后不明人士不断追捕她，故事便围绕这个婴儿展开。

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sekirei]Wikipedia[/url]]
